purpose: Frozen held-out PEMS H12 test release for the resource-qualified full-coverage MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate and same-source baselines.
research_question: On four PEMS traffic datasets at H12, is the d24 full-coverage MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate non-inferior to fixed linear, patch, periodic, inverted-variable, multi-scale MLP, and plain-Mamba baselines while retaining its measured forward-latency advantage over TimeMixer?
evidence_boundary: The selection phase is validation-only. Test metrics are generated only by the frozen confirmation phases and are read once after every phase passes strict validation; no test value selects an arm, epoch, architecture, or hyperparameter.
claim_boundary: This release supports only the registered PEMS H12 claim family. It does not establish long-horizon, graph-aware, or general time-series superiority, and AutoCon causal attribution remains bounded by the validation active/null evidence.

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The d24 full-coverage MambaTS v3 AutoCon architecture and lambda=0.001 are frozen from the prior PEMS H12 validation/resource protocol; this phase only verifies the exact executable contract before test release.

confirmation_contract.test_read_gate: Aggregate only after every registered phase validator succeeds and the test metrics cannot change the matrix.
confirmation_contract.independence_note: Forecast windows and channels are not inferential replicates; seed-level paired contrasts are the uncertainty unit.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share dataset split, features, sequence length, horizon, maximum epochs, patience, optimizer, scheduler, batch, and normalization. d_model/d_ff are frozen at the candidate protocol.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: External baselines are fixed same-source references; report parameter and latency counts separately and do not attribute unmatched capacity differences to the Mamba operator.

accuracy_claim_contract.boundary: The primary claim is restricted to PatchTST and Mamba2; other baselines are mandatory descriptive rows.

phases.name: selection_pems_d24_candidate_validation
phases.purpose: Validation-only contract check for the frozen d24 full-coverage MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate.

phases.name: confirmatory_pems_d24_candidate_test
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate held-out test phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_pems_strong_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Fixed same-source PEMS H12 reference models under the identical test contract.

statistical_gate.paired_effect: seed-level log(MSE_candidate / MSE_baseline) and raw scaled-MSE delta
statistical_gate.interpretation: A registered PEMS cell is non-inferior only when the one-sided paired seed-level upper bound is no worse than 1.02; otherwise it is inconclusive or unfavorable.
statistical_gate.small_n_warning: Five seeds remain modest and do not support universal claims.

resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Only report speed against a named comparator when the corresponding accuracy gate passes; never claim speed over DLinear/NLinear without a separate qualified analysis.

prelaunch_gates: verify four PEMS hashes and exact 172-job expansion
keep test metrics out of selection
run all phases under the immutable launch sidecar
read test metrics only after all strict phase validators pass
